## Google bans kids from searching

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ac90191f-30aa-4e53-85c3-c6f159bd24e2/38837bdb-83a2-4d03-9255-73b265ce66f4.jpg?t=1793781379)
Caption: 

Schools that don't want AI in class are about to [lose Google Search too](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/us/google-search-schools-restrict-ai.html).

Starting early next year, Gemini and Google Search will be switched off for K-12 student accounts until the school's admins turn them on.

They only come as a pair. Google's head of education told The New York Times that Search and AI are now so tied together that schools can't keep one and drop the other. Kinda forcing schools that don’t want AI to keep using it, or lose the best search engine there is.

* Students at schools that keep AI off will see a message that Search is unavailable.

* Google is also testing Guided Learning in Search, which walks students through homework step by step, starting with some US schools this month.

* It only covers accounts the school manages, so homework on Mom's laptop still gets Google.

Google says schools will get the details in the coming months.

81935.subject: Agentic Money Laundering is the wrong story about the $6.3B Binance hack 🤖💸; Stripe now lets AI Agents spend you…
81935.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1147

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re diving deep into the $6.34B Binance hack, the largest crypto heist of all time and already being called the first case of agentic money laundering, to see what the evidence actually shows about AI’s role and what founders, operators & investors building in payments, stablecoins & AI agents should do about it (what the on-chain data says about AI in the laundering, the 4 steps from a fake job interview to Binance’s signing service via its own internal AI tool, why switching off withdrawals didn’t stop the drain, what it means for agent wallets & stablecoin issuers, & what’s next + bonus deep dive into After the Click: The Playbook for the New Internet Era [ https://substack.com/redirect/00fc9afa-7367-4224-8950-bd88c70958d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and breakind down Link Balance, Stripe’s new feature that lets AI agents spend your money while you sleep (how it works, why it runs on stables that merchants never see, why shoppers got it before businesses, & the one number to watch next + bonus deep dives into How AI Agents Reshaped Jobs, Hiring and Productivity at Anthropic [ https://substack.com/redirect/087ffa7c-bbd9-4250-bcde-aa50bcc7ac0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Run a One-Person Company on Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/4ca772b1-dc6c-4c67-96f0-b8c8a9cc5d57?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Agentic Money Laundering is the wrong story about the $6.3 billion Binance hack 🤖💸
Following the money 💸 The October 29 Binance hack is now being called by some the first case of agentic money laundering, but the evidence points somewhere else.
Binance’s own incident report on the $6.34 billion theft, which the FBI attributes to North Korea’s TraderTraitor unit, finds AI in how the attackers got in. Nobody has found it in how they moved the money. The attackers used the exchange’s internal AI tool to take over two wallet engineers’ computers 9 days before the money moved.
If you build payments, stablecoin or AI-agent products, that changes where you should be looking. The weak point was AI tooling inside the victim, and the theft ran through a delegated permission Binance couldn’t quickly revoke. Issuer freezes, led by Tether and Circle, held back $2.85 billion within the first hours, which no AML monitoring came close to.
Let’s dive deeper into this to see what the on-chain data really says about AI in the laundering, the four steps from a fake job interview to Binance’s signing service, why switching off withdrawals didn’t stop the drain, and the on-chain pattern that would be the first real evidence of agentic money laundering...

Unsubscribe https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9saW5hcy5z

81932.subject: AVALANCHE OCTOBER 2026 RECAP
81932.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-october-2026-recap

October was the month Summit’s momentum turned into policy and capital. South Korea’s Financial Services Commission moved from exploring tokenization to publishing rules for it, institutions from Hyundai to Charles Schwab kept naming Avalanche directly, and Team1 Japan became Team1’s 10th global chapter.
Avalanche also launched Avalanche Originals, a new series taking viewers behind the scenes with the builders Summit introduced.
Here’s everything that happened in October.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Avalanche Leads All Chains in Tokenized Stock Growth:
Avalanche added more tokenized stock market cap than any other chain in September, up $245.5 million and led by Securitize. [Stock Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/6cad1406-48b9-4a5c-9e93-231ebe85392a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Tokenized Treasuries Are Up 4x This Year:
Tokenized U.S. Treasuries on Avalanche climbed 14% in Q3 alone to $545 million, now four times where they started the year. [Treasuries [ https://substack.com/redirect/c05f9abb-8008-421c-b446-cd9992fd355c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Pharaoh Exchange Hits a Record Month:
Avalanche’s top DEX posted all-time high monthly volume and fees, coming right off announcing 24/7 permissionless stock trading. [Pharaoh [ https://substack.com/redirect/268cd9e9-907b-4258-aefc-d46af180ca1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Japan Becomes the 10th Global Chapter:
Team1 Japan officially launched after 30 events across four cities, 1,200 attendees, 18 Avalanche Gourmet Nights, and four institutional events, with the Foundation welcoming the milestone as proof of Japan’s growing institutional adoption.
Team1 Chapters Build Across the Globe:
Team1 chapters remained active globally this month. Türkiye held UniTour #3 across three cities and six universities before hosting its first hackathon with OKX Türkiye, attracting 60+ developers and 30 projects. Vietnam reached 250+ students through its VKU Uni Tour, hosted a She Build meetup and opened registration for a 420-builder UniHack. Africa held workshops in Zaria and Warri, Nigeria, and an Avalanche Academy session in Johannesburg. Thailand hosted its first Kasetsart University session, while first-ever meetups took place in Lviv and Shenzhen.
In the U.S., Team1 held a Blockchain x AI event during SF Tech Week and launched its weekly Team1 Break X Spaces. India partnered with India Blockchain Week ahead of its November 2 Mumbai Networking Gala, while Brazil announced a trading card meetup with YourGrails and NYC hosted a rooftop meetup with The Grotto.

Hoci slovenský pracovný trh v roku 2026 mierne ochladol, pri technologických pozíciách zostáva nedostatok kvalifikovaných ľudí výrazný. OECD upozorňuje, že počet voľných miest v ICT profesiách v prepočte na zamestnaného je na Slovensku o 142 % vyšší než priemer naprieč celým trhom práce. Firmy tak pri skúsených technologických odborníkoch stále nesúperia len s domácou konkurenciou, ale často aj so zahraničnými zamestnávateľmi.  Mení sa pritom aj to, čo kandidáti od firmy očakávajú. Plat zostáva dôležitý, no sám o sebe nemusí rozhodnúť. Význam má stabilita firmy, obsah práce, kvalita tímu aj možnosť profesijne rásť. Prieskum napríklad ukázal, že nemožnosť kariérneho postupu patrí medzi najčastejšie dôvody odchodu zamestnancov. Štvrtina respondentov zároveň uvažovala o zmene aj preto, že si nebola istá budúcnosťou firmy. Práve tieto témy riešil počas rýchleho rastu aj košický tím Caterpillaru. V neistom období rastie hodnota stability Podľa Mareka Uhrína z Caterpillaru sa v posledných rokoch citeľne zmenila jedna vec: kandidáti sa oveľa viac pýtajú, či má firma dlhodobú perspektívu. Ekonomická neistota, globálne dianie a rýchly nástup AI totiž zasahujú aj profesie, ktoré ešte nedávno pôsobili mimoriadne stabilne. „Kandidáti hľadajú stabilného zamestnávateľa, ktorý je na trhu dlho a má silný produkt, ktorý dokáže ustáť aj neisté časy,“ vysvetľuje Uhrín. Druhým faktorom je podľa neho samotná práca. Technologickí experti nechcú iba ďalšiu položku v životopise, ale projekty, pri ktorých riešia náročný problém a vidia reálny výsledok. V Košiciach Caterpillar pracuje na desiatkach digitálnych projektov pre stroje značky Cat. Firma práve globálny dosah práce považuje za jednu zo svojich výhod pri nábore – vývojár nepracuje na izolovanom internom nástroji, ale na riešení, ktoré môže ovplyvniť fungovanie strojov v praxi. Pri rýchlom raste firma neznížila nároky Rýchlo rastúci tím často rieši nepríjemnú dilemu: obsadiť pozíciu rýchlejšie alebo čakať na človeka, ktorý zapadne odborne aj ľudsky. Caterpillar si podľa Uhrína vybral druhú cestu. „Od košického tímu sú v Caterpillare očakávané veľké veci, kvalitne a rýchlo dodané riešenia a najmä konzistentnosť,“ hovorí.
